Write a launch recommendation for gate_40.

The experiment for gate_40 shows a statistically significant negative effect on retention at day 7 (primary metric). The treatment arm had an 18.2% retention rate compared to 19.02% in the control, representing a -0.82 percentage point difference with a p-value of 0.00155. While the experiment was adequately powered for the pre-registered effect size, the observed effect is in the opposite direction and statistically significant.

**Recommendation: Do not ship gate_40.** The treatment significantly harms retention at day 7 compared to gate_30.

memo.answer: The gate_40 treatment significantly reduced retention at day 7 compared to the control, with a -0.82 percentage point difference (p-value: 0.00155) where the treatment rate was 18.2% versus 19.02% in the control arm.
risks: The treatment significantly harms retention at day 7, which is the primary metric for this experiment.

Although the experiment was adequately powered (96.63% power at the pre-registered effect size), the observed negative effect is statistically significant and in the opposite direction of a positive launch goal.
